listeners.description: List of endpoints for Condure to listen on (HTTP and/or WebSocket). Each entry defines an address, port, and optional TLS.

tls.description: TLS configuration. If omitted, plain HTTP/WebSocket is used.

cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format).

key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format).

trusted_proxies.description: List of trusted proxy IP addresses or CIDRs. Enables X-Forwarded-* header parsing only from these sources.

http2.description: HTTP/2 protocol settings. Enable only if downstream supports it.

max_concurrent_streams.description: Maximum number of concurrent streams per HTTP/2 connection.

initial_connection_window_size.description: Initial flow control window size for HTTP/2 connections (bytes).

initial_stream_window_size.description: Initial flow control window size for HTTP/2 streams (bytes).

ping_interval.description: Seconds between WebSocket ping frames to keep connections alive.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of idle time before closing a WebSocket connection.

max_frame_size.description: Maximum size (bytes) of a WebSocket frame. Larger frames are rejected.

level.description: Minimum log level: debug, info, warn, error, fatal.

output.description: Path to log file. Omit to log to stderr.

requests_per_second.description: Max requests per second per client IP (for HTTP/WebSocket).

burst_size.description: Maximum burst allowance before rate limiting kicks in.

connections_per_ip.description: Maximum concurrent connections allowed per client IP.
